basis: NBA 2K release snapshots use prior completed season; 2K25/26 updated snapshots use edition-ending season. Benchmark, not official season-final roster.

kinds.final: latest in-season roster update of the edition played during the season
kinds.next: launch roster of the following edition (built from the season's play)
kinds.preseason: fallback: launch roster of the edition played during the season (projection made before it)
kinds.retro: fallback: a later game's classic-team rating of that exact season
